## Goal
Create the User model with UUID primary key per vault 03-data-model.md.

## Context (read first)
The user entity is foundational — every other model references it. Per binding C-001, the codebase already has a user.ts stub; this unit fills it with the full schema. Per constitution A-001, use strict TypeScript. Per A-002, explicit return types on all methods.

## Anchors
- src/models/user.ts:12 — existing stub (binding C-001)

## Hard rules
- DO NOT modify src/middleware/auth.ts
- file:src/models/user.ts MUST follow camelCase naming

## Anti-patterns
- Don't use `any` type (constitution A-001)
- Don't use CommonJS require() (constitution A-003)

## Implementation steps
Open src/models/user.ts and replace the stub with the full entity definition. Use UUID v4 for the primary key per OQ-DM-1 resolution. Add email, name, role, created_at fields per vault data model.

## Acceptance criteria
- User model compiles with strict TypeScript
- UUID primary key generates correctly
- Test file covers CRUD operations
